title: Before Oct. 7 Attack, Netanyahu Was Warned, Report Says. He Denies It.
summary_full: Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu said he would sue the newspaper Haaretz after it reported that the Emirati president had warned him Hamas was planning a major operation against Israel.
